main_claim: After beating Soriano, Donchenko says he wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally at the last event of the year.
quote: Donchenko (15-2 MMA, 4-0 UFC) name-dropped who he wants next. That's longtime UFC welterweight Daniel Rodriguez
note: The article is built on his callout, which is a wish, so no fact. Unsure on fact because the article is published the day after the fight and also tells the decision win over Soriano, which an editor could read as result news rather than background.

main_claim: Reporter Alvaro Colmenero says Topuria will return to the public eye in September after healing in July and holidays in August.
quote: I do know that Ilia is going to return to the public eye directly in the month of September
note: A named journalist states that he is coming back into public after time away; no specific fight exists, the Gaethje/Pimblett lines are closing background.

main_claim: Donchenko vs Soriano is listed on the main card of UFC Paris, whose start times and broadcast the article gives.
quote: Main Card: ... Welterweight: Daniil Donchenko vs Punahele Soriano
note: He is only a name in the card list; the guide puts card order and start times under fight_week_event, but an editor could equally say a card list carries nothing new about him (no_fact, firmness none). The booking itself is the premise, so next fight is no.

main_claim: UFC commentator Jon Anik says the UFC is having internal conversations about an immediate Gaethje vs Topuria rematch.
quote: I think there are internal conversations to potentially try to do Gaethje vs. Topuria 2.
note: A rumour of talks with a named speaker, so next_fight. Firmness could be read as reported because a named person states it, but he says 'I think' and it is early 'conversations', which the guide lists under rumour.

main_claim: Makhachev says he agreed to fight Topuria at the White House event but it fell through, according to his manager, because Topuria's side asked for more money.
quote: Decía que les ofrecieron la pelea, preguntaron por más dinero, no se lo dieron y por eso eligieron no pelear conmigo
note: none_of_these: the new fact is a past negotiation revealed (a fight that was offered and did not happen), not where he stands now and not a fight that exists or changes. Stated by another fighter, so reported.

main_claim: Gaethje, who will not fight again in 2026, doubts a Topuria rematch is next and guesses Topuria will not fight until next year either.
quote: I guess if I'm not fighting until next year, [Topuria is] probably not going to fight until next year, too
note: The article is Gaethje's own news; about Topuria there is only his guess at timing and his opinion on the rematch, which the guide counts as no fact.

main_claim: Topuria's favourite restaurant in Spain is Nou Collonet on the island of Tabarca, near Alicante.
quote: El lugar predilecto de Topuria para disfrutar de la gastronomía de nuestro país es el restaurante Nou Collonet
note: Life outside the cage, so personal_life. Unsure because it is a lifestyle feature with no dated news and no named source for the claim; an editor could call it no_fact with firmness none.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nobody has spoken to him about it.
quote: Now, with rumors swirling that Topuria could make his UFC return against Pimblett ... “Nothing yet. No one’s spoke to me about it, so we’ll see what happens.”
note: This text gives the rumour no substance (no who, no date, no event), so by the guide it is a wish piece. An editor could instead read it as a rumoured fight being denied by its subject, which would be next_fight at rumour with next fight yes.

main_claim: Donchenko and Soriano faced off at the UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins.
quote: Daniil Donchenko vs. Punahele Soriano, UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins faceoff
note: The saved text is only the headline plus page furniture; the headline is a weigh-in face-off, which has happened. The booking is the premise, not news.

main_claim: Topuria breaks nearly three months of silence with a video message to his son Hugo about not fearing defeat.
quote: Las primeras palabras de Ilia Topuria después de perder el cinturón ... han ido dirigidas a una persona en particular, Hugo, su hijo
note: The message is about his son and a life lesson, which the guide lists under personal_life, and the specific value is picked before status_update. An editor could pick status_update (back in public after time away) or no_fact (reflection only).

main_claim: In an essay on his website Topuria speaks for the first time about the Gaethje loss, lists the fractures he suffered, and says the defeat made him want to return more.
quote: las dos órbitas de los ojos fracturadas, el tabique y el pie rotos
note: He himself states his injuries inside the words the article is built on, which the guide rules as health, official. Unsure because the essay is mainly reflection and an editor could say no_fact, or status_update for 'seguía queriendo volver'.

main_claim: Topuria writes on his website about his first loss, naming the injuries he took and saying the defeat made him more eager to return.
quote: both orbital bones fractured, my septum broken, and my foot broken
note: Same essay as the guide's worked example: his own statement of his fractures is the one hard fact, so health, official. An editor could still call a reflection piece no_fact.

main_claim: After the official weigh-in, where both men weighed 77.11 kg, Donchenko says he is fine and plans to be about 86 kg by the evening.
quote: Обидва бійці показали вагу 77,11 кг
note: Weigh-in news and his words about rehydrating are fight-week routine; the Soriano fight on 5 September is the premise, not news.

main_claim: Topuria's physical trainer Jesús Gallo says his recovery from the fractures is going very well and that he could be physically ready by December, though spring 2027 is the sensible return.
quote: Su preparador físico, Jesús Gallo, ha asegurado que "tiene un poder de recuperación increíble"
note: A named member of his team states how the recovery is going, and the guide says that is health even when the same statement gives a return date. Unsure because the headline is about the return date, which on its own would be status_update.

main_claim: Pimblett says the UFC has not contacted him about the December fight with Topuria that coach Tim Welch said he had heard rumours of.
quote: Tim Welch, who coaches Sean O'Malley, claimed he heard rumors that Pimblett and Topuria could meet before the end of the year.
note: A rumour with substance (who said it, and a December date), denied by its subject: the guide counts that as next_fight at rumour.

main_claim: Pimblett says he has had no call about the rumoured UFC 335 fight with Topuria on December 12, a rumour reported by coach Tim Welch.
quote: Sean O’Malley’s coach, Tim Welch, recently claimed to have heard rumors of the potential matchup taking place on December 12.
note: The rumour has a named source, a date and an event, and Anik's 'internal conversations' about the Gaethje rematch are added beside it; both are next-fight rumours.

main_claim: Donchenko will fight Punahele Soriano on 5 September at UFC Fight Night in Paris.
quote: Данило Донченко проведе свій наступний поєдинок 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night у Парижі. Суперником 24-річного українця стане американець Пунахеле Соріано.
note: The booking is the news, stated flatly as set. The article names no source for it, so an editor could choose reported instead of official.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and that either a Gaethje rematch or a Pimblett fight would suit the UFC.
quote: Topuria está listo para pelear, y nosotros estamos preparados para él. Ambas opciones [el combate contra Gaethje o el de Paddy] me parecen bien.
note: The promotion states he is ready and names opponents only as options, which is status_update. The line on his fractures is the writer's own recap, not a statement by someone named.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight, nothing is scheduled yet, and both the Gaethje rematch and a Pimblett fight are good options.
quote: No lo tenemos en la agenda por ahora, pero escucha: Topuria está listo para pelea. Nosotros estamos listos para él
note: The promotion says he is ready, nothing is booked, and opponents are only options: status_update, official. No specific fight exists or changes.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria next but that nobody has talked to him about it.
quote: Nadie me ha hablado de eso (una pelea con Ilia), así que veremos qué pasa
note: The article is the writer's analysis of options plus Pimblett's wish; the talk of a Pimblett fight has no named source, date or event, so it is a wish piece. An editor could read Pimblett's denial of negotiations, or the passing line that Anik says the Gaethje rematch will happen, as a next-fight rumour (next_fight, rumour, yes).
